text:
Dataset collection agreement

By giving both confirmations below, you sign this agreement electronically and confirm:
1. I am at least 18 and an adult under the laws where I live, I do not live in Illinois, Colorado, Texas or Washington, these recordings are of me only, and I agree to this collection agreement.
2. I explicitly consent to the collection and use of my eye images, which may contain biometric and health-related information, and to their transfer to and storage in the United States, as described in this notice.

Who we are. Fovea Labs LLC, a company in the United States, decides how this collection is used (the "controller") and operates it for EyeTrackVR. Privacy contact for questions and requests: support@fovea-labs.com. Our postal address and the name of our representative are available on request from that address.

What we collect. Your eye-camera recordings (close-up infrared images of your eyes and the skin around them), capture labels and timing, camera and capture settings, the headset description you type, and a record of your consent (notice version and fingerprint, and dates).

Sensitive data. Close-up eye images can show iris and retina patterns, which some laws treat as biometric identifiers or biometric data (for example the GDPR and Japan's APPI). They can also reveal health-related traits such as eye conditions, pupil responses or tiredness. We collect them only with your explicit consent in the second confirmation. We never use them to identify or verify anyone, to infer your emotions, health or other personal characteristics, to profile you, or for advertising.

Purpose. Only to develop, train, test and evaluate EyeTrackVR eye-tracking models and software, and to review submissions for quality, for example sorting them by headset.

Permission for your contribution. You give Fovea Labs LLC a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free permission to use your contribution for this purpose. The permission ends when you withdraw, except for models already trained or released before then (see Model releases). You keep any rights you have in your contribution.

Legal basis. We rely on your explicit consent for the stated purpose, including the collection of your eye images, under GDPR Art. 6(1)(a) and 9(2)(a) and equivalent rules elsewhere. Short-lived pseudonymous network counters and connection processing protect the service from abuse, based on our legitimate interests (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)); you can object to them. We keep the minimal consent and deletion record to prove consent and deletion and to establish or defend legal claims (legitimate interests and legal obligations). Giving us data is voluntary and is not required by law or by any contract.

Who receives it. Authorized Fovea Labs LLC maintainers; Cloudflare, Inc., our service provider for encrypted storage, network connections and human verification (Cloudflare Turnstile, which processes browser and device signals to tell people from bots); AI model providers acting as our service providers, which may receive a few sample frames from your recording and your headset description to help us screen and sort submissions, only under terms that forbid them from using it to train their own models or for any other purpose; and authorities where the law requires it. We do not sell, rent, lease or trade your contribution, or share it for cross-context or targeted advertising.

Model releases. Raw recordings are never published. Trained models and related software may be released publicly and used by others under their published licenses. Released models contain learned numerical parameters, not your recordings, and we do not include recordings in model releases. Withdrawal stops all future use and training. Models already released, and copies others have made, may not be recallable; we will assess affected models and take any further steps the law requires.

Where your data goes. Fovea Labs LLC is in the United States, and your contribution is sent to and stored in the United States (Cloudflare storage in Western North America). Cloudflare may also handle connection and verification traffic in other countries where it operates. The United States has no single comprehensive federal privacy law equivalent to the EU GDPR, the UK GDPR, Switzerland's FADP or Japan's APPI; protection there comes from sector-specific and state laws, and the level of protection may differ from your country. Our safeguards: your contribution is encrypted on your computer before upload, so the hosting provider stores only data it cannot read; Cloudflare processes it under its data processing addendum, which incorporates the EU Standard Contractual Clauses with the UK and Swiss addenda; and access and deletion follow this notice. You can ask us for a copy of these safeguards. Where your law requires your consent to send data abroad, you give it with the second confirmation.

Security. The app encrypts your contribution (age encryption) to Fovea Labs LLC maintainer keys built into the app. Only authorized Fovea Labs LLC maintainers can decrypt it, on access-controlled machines. No system is perfectly secure. If a breach occurs, we will notify the authorities, and affected people where we can reach them, as the law requires.

How long we keep it. This is our written retention and destruction schedule.
- Raw recordings and your headset description: kept with no fixed end date, until you withdraw or until they are no longer useful for developing, testing or evaluating EyeTrackVR eye-tracking models, whichever comes first. We review stored recordings at least every 3 years and delete those we no longer need. Rejected submissions are deleted promptly, normally within 24 hours. Maintainer copies, including training copies and caches made from them, follow the same schedule; the sync tool deletes local copies once a submission is withdrawn, rejected or deleted.
- Consent and deletion record (submission ID, type, status, notice version and fingerprint, dates, sizes and checksums; no recording, report text or headset description): kept for up to 365 days after the content is deleted, then deleted.
- Abuse-prevention counters (a keyed, daily-rotating fingerprint of your network address, never the address itself): about two to three days.
- Database recovery history can keep deleted records for up to 7 more days (30 days on a paid Cloudflare plan). Backups and restored systems follow this schedule and honor withdrawals.

Withdrawing. You can withdraw at any time, as easily as you agreed: use Your contributions in the app, the CLI, or email support@fovea-labs.com with your submission ID. Keep your private receipt; it lets you withdraw without contacting us. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing before it. On withdrawal we immediately block downloads of the hosted copy, scheduled cleanup deletes it (normally within 24 hours) and maintainers delete their copies before any further use. If you lose your receipt, contact us and we will reasonably try to locate your contribution without asking for identity documents.

Your rights. Depending on where you live (for example the EU/EEA, UK, Switzerland, US states, Japan, South Korea, China, Brazil, Canada or Australia), you can ask to access or get a copy of your data, correct it, delete it, restrict or object to its use, receive it in a portable format, learn who received it and where it was sent, and withdraw consent. We will not treat you differently for using these rights. Email support@fovea-labs.com. We reply within the period your law requires, and no later than one month. To find your contribution we may ask for your submission ID or capture details. If we refuse a request, we will explain why; you can appeal by replying to our answer, and if the appeal is denied you can contact your state attorney general (US) or a data-protection authority, such as your EU or Swiss supervisory authority, the UK ICO, Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission or Korea's PIPC. You can complain to an authority at any time. No decision with legal or similarly significant effect about you is made solely by automated means; people decide on submissions.

Who may contribute. Only adults (18 or older and adults under the laws where they live), and only data about themselves. This collection is not offered to people who live in Illinois, Colorado, Texas or Washington. Do not upload another person's recordings, private communications, passwords, access tokens or other people's personal information. We do not ask for your name, email address, account, date of birth, headset serial number or an installation identifier, but recordings may still identify you; we do not promise anonymity.

Your choice. Contributing is optional. EyeTrackVR works the same if you never contribute or later withdraw. Contributions are unpaid.

Changes. If this notice changes, the app shows the new version and asks you again before anything uploads under it. We will not use an existing contribution for a new purpose without new consent.

Statutory rights. Nothing in this notice limits or waives rights you have under mandatory law.
